purpose: Authoritative implementation instruction set for the NFL Football Intelligence & Development OS
scope: NFL football only; organization, team, season, player, coach, scheme, playbook, practice, performance, film, scouting, analytics, rules, knowledge, governance, data, UX, engineering, and delivery
locked_principles: human authority above recommendations and locked changes
provenance, context, uncertainty, and disagreement remain visible
agents are callable specialists with declared permissions
canonical records are versioned and auditable
no unsupported assertion becomes canonical automatically

stage_sequence.work: scope, capability discovery, dependency architecture, gap audit, owner approval

stage_sequence.exit_evidence: development, lesson, mastery, and workflow tests
play compiler, playbook architecture, and contracts
film intelligence, observation, correction, and QA tests
game plan architecture and countermeasure tests
this artifact, validator, and traceability tests

permission_rules: agents cannot silently lock or approve artifacts
health-related decisions escalate to qualified staff
human approval required for stage, change, and release gates
coding_standards: source and context are required for high-value claims
schemas and documentation change with implementation
errors are machine-readable where exposed through APIs
change_control: material scope or schema change requires CR-* request
impact analysis must identify affected CAP/OBJ/WF/DEC IDs
locked terminology and rule authority changes require human approval
release requires passed evals, governance audit, and approver
acceptance_criteria: no critical permission or safety failure is open
audit history exists for persisted changes
allowed_changes: new versioned contracts with impact analysis
new tests, evals, validators, and audit evidence
prohibited_changes: expanding beyond NFL scope without approved change request
silently changing locked terminology or schema semantics
promoting unsupported hypotheses or assertions as canonical facts
bypassing human approval for locked artifacts
cross-organization access without explicit approved scope
deleting canonical history or audit events
traceability_requirements: Every CAP-* has owner, dependencies, priority, risks, and acceptance criteria
Every stage has an exit gate and evidence
Every production-facing feature maps to tests and eval families
Every canonical record maps to a schema and audit behavior
